summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K on 17 July 2026 announcing the conclusion of an audit tender process. The Board, upon recommendation of the Audit Risk Committee, decided to re-appoint Deloitte LLP as external auditor for the financial year ending 31 December 2028. This follows regulatory requirements for Public Interest Entities to tender every 10 years and rotate every 20. Deloitte was initially appointed from the 2018 financial year. A shareholder resolution for re-appointment will be proposed at the 2028 Annual General Meeting. This is a routine corporate governance matter, not a special situation.
